inherited_decisions: D001-D013 from v2 remain binding without semantic change

entries_added.rule: Candidate validation and active-frontier validation are distinct deterministic modes. A workflow must select the mode solely from the stable pointer version; it may not blindly reuse candidate-parent checks after promotion.

Before scientific execution resumes after a frontier promotion, an external active-mode run must compile from the stable pointer without --target, pass the independent oracle, and prove its ticket_id equals the machine_action_ticket_id recorded in the stable pointer.

V244 pre-promotion kernel validation is valid evidence, but its post-promotion workflow integration failed with CANDIDATE_PARENT_VERSION_MISMATCH; no scorer execution is permitted until the two-mode validation architecture is promoted and active-mode PASS is persisted.

decision: V3_FROZEN: TWO_PHASE_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION IS MANDATORY; CANDIDATE_MODE BEFORE PROMOTION AND ACTIVE_MODE AFTER PROMOTION
